{{Quote|Hey, hey, hey, what's going on here?|Hype Fazon discovers First Order troopers in his hangar|audio=HypeFazonsHangarBay-TheDisappeared.flac|<ref name="The Disappeared" />}}
'''Hype Fazon's hangar bay''', designated '''hangar C2''', was a [[hangar]] located on the ''[[Colossus]]'' [[refueling station]] and was used by the [[Ace Squadron|Ace]] [[pilot]] [[Hype Fazon]] as his personal hangar. Fazon stored his [[Racing starfighter|racer]], the ''[[Green Ace]]'', there. In [[34 ABY]], after the occupying [[First Order]] grounded all pilots on the ''Colossus'', an upset Fazon had a run-in with several [[First Order stormtrooper]]s in his hangar bay after they locked down his [[Starfighter|ship]], leading to his [[Prison|arrest]].

==Description==
[[File:Green_Ace.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Hype Fazon docked the ''Green Ace'' in his personal hangar.]]
Hype Fazon's hangar bay<ref name="Bucket's List">{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-disappeared-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 6 Fun Facts from "The Disappeared" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}}</ref> was a [[hangar]] used by the [[Ace Squadron]] [[pilot]] [[Hype Fazon]] aboard the ''[[Colossus]]'' [[refueling station]]. Located in the platform's [[Doza Tower]]<ref name="The Disappeared" /> and designated hangar C2,<ref name="Bucket's List" /> the hangar was a large space that Fazon used to store his [[racing starfighter]], the ''[[Green Ace]]''. It also included several barrels and crates. Fazon's name and logo were detailed on the floor and wall in [[Color|green]] [[Aurebesh]] lettering,<ref name="The Disappeared" /> so that no one mistook who the hangar was used by.<ref name="Bucket's List" /> Green and yellow elements also decorated the interior.<ref name="The Disappeared" /> The [[Rodian]] kept the hangar clean and in good shape, unlike many other hangars on the station.<ref name="Bucket's List" /> There were several entrances to the hangar, including one that led to a large corridor.<ref name="The Disappeared" />

==History==
{{Quote|His ship is locked down.|Torra Doza, to Kazuda Xiono, upon sneaking into Hype's hangar|audio=HypeFazonsHangarBay2-TheDisappeared.flac|<ref name="The Disappeared" />}}
[[File:HypesArrest-TheDisappeared.png|thumb|left|280px|Hype Fazon was apprehended by First Order stormtroopers in his hangar.]]
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|1|18}}</ref> after [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]] informed the Aces in the [[Aces' Lounge]] that the occupying [[First Order]] had restricted non-military pilots from flying, preventing the Aces from being in the air and effectively shutting down all [[Racer|racing]] events, Fazon vehemently reacted to the news and stormed off to his hangar, accompanied by his [[astromech droid]] [[R4-G77]]. Entering the hangar, Fazon witnessed a trio of [[First Order stormtrooper]]s locking down the ''Green Ace'' with a clamp. Fazon declared that he was going to run speed trials in his [[Starfighter|ship]], but the [[trooper]]s informed him that his [[Starship|ship]] was now grounded. After calling the trooper a "[[nerko]]" and putting his hands on them, Fazon was then [[Prisoner|arrested]].<ref name="The Disappeared" />

After several other ''Colossus'' occupants noticed Fazon's absence and discussed it in [[Aunt Z's Tavern]], a group of First Order stormtroopers lied by stating that Fazon had left the ''Colossus'' entirely. Fazon's fellow Ace [[Torra Doza]] became worried and enlisted the help of [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] to investigate. As Doza Tower was on lockdown, with even Aces like Torra restricted from going to certain areas, Xiono's astromech [[droid]] companion [[CB-23]] helped them create a distraction that allowed them to take a [[turbolift]] up to the level of Fazon's hangar.<ref name="The Disappeared" />

[[File:HangarC2-TheDisappeared.jpg|thumb|260px|right|Xiono and Doza discover Fazon's racer on lock-down in the hangar.]]
Inside hangar C2, Doza and Xiono discovered that Fazon's ''Green Ace'' was locked down. With Doza noting that Fazon would not have left the platform without it, the two agreed that the alleged story about Fazon's departure must be false. Xiono felt the First Order must be behind his absence. Just then, two stormtroopers entered the hangar for a routine check, and as the two ''Colossus'' residents hid behind a group of barrels, the troopers discussed how the ''Green Ace'' would soon be scrapped. Doza and Xiono would search for Fazon and eventually locate him and two other First Order prisoners in the [[West Docks]].<ref name="The Disappeared" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hype Fazon's hangar bay appeared in "[[The Disappeared]],"<ref name="The Disappeared" /> the eighteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. The episode premiered on [[February 24]], [[2019]].<ref name="Air date">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> The hangar was first pictured in the Season One mid-season trailer on [[January 9]] of that year,<ref name="Midseason">{{SWYouTube|m7Pls-vYWwM|Star Wars Resistance Season 1 - Mid-Season Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/season-1-mid-season-trailer-star-wars-resistance}}</ref> and was first identified in a [[StarWars.com]] article posted the [[February 25|day]] after the episode's release.<ref name="Bucket's List" /> Concept art of titled "Hype Fazon hangar" was done by artist [[Colas Gauthier]], dated to [[September 19]], [[2017]].<ref name="Concept">{{SW|url=star-wars-resistance-the-disappeared-concept-art-gallery|text="The Disappeared" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}}</ref>
